Keep chronological accepted raw labels, mean/population-SD normalization with floor0.001, raw radius2 count-Tanimoto geometry, training nugget0.05^2, inherited training and pool jitter/factor arithmetic, alpha and raw pool mean mu. Keep nu=3, beta=z^T C^-1 z (the original whitened calculation and z^T alpha cross-check), d=3+n, b=(1+beta)/2 and r=(1+beta)/(1+n). From the original normal call and factor F form E=Z F^T. Both conditional laws have mean mu and implemented covariance s^2*r*(F F^T); the analytic unjittered Schur covariance and factor-defined stabilized covariance remain separately named. The ordinary GP reference has covariance s^2*(F F^T). No extra query observation noise, clipping, fitted scalar, changed nu, alternate normalization or conditional law switching is introduced. The active Gaussian and old TP differ jointly in marginal tails and non-Gaussian shared radial dependence; the total shape contrast cannot separate those two properties. Preserve the same mean-based gate, original row order, independently updated availability and first-index sequential maxima. Changed actual purchases can propagate through accepted labels into later fits, survivors and breeding under the same laws. Mean/covariance/mask equality is a common-state identity, not equality of later adaptive histories or an improvement in mean ordering.

finding_summary.headline: Gaussian shape changes accepted purchases but loses endpoints on every seed; the gain prediction is refuted.
finding_summary.insights: The joint-law replacement executed and materially changed search, while its conditional endpoint-improvement prediction failed. This tests the total shape change; marginal tails and shared radial dependence remain inseparable. All 4,200 available next-fit joins succeeded, with 150 terminal records kept separate. Full generating-parent gain rose from 14.4408 to 15.0001, while late gain fell from 4.8820 to 4.4332 and incumbent gain fell. Local parent-beating progress therefore did not translate into a better final maximum on this panel. The unchanged mean ranking still misordered 5,726 of 19,511 strict pairs; a ranking-model change would address a different measured limitation than joint-law shape, with its benefit untested here. Molecular evidence likewise shows broad pooled scaffold coverage alongside narrow high-label subsets, persistent small and large size tails, and unspecified configuration; these are search-output limitations, not proof of what caused the score loss or of chemical utility. This result leaves the wider Student-t approach and retained-component attribution open.
finding_summary.results: All fifteen sessions completed, with 4,500 accepted calls and 435 verified pool laws. The Gaussian law changed 213 accepted purchases relative to same-state Student-t selection, including 58 late purchases; all normal and radial streams remained paired. Macro score was 0.554077 versus the code Parent’s 0.572802, a loss of 0.018725 against the registered +0.002 prediction. Eight task/seed endpoints improved, six worsened and one tied, but all three seed means fell. Sitagliptin supplied 95.0% of the net deficit. Same-paid Gaussian, old Student-t and original GP pinball losses were 0.02085143, 0.02085013 and 0.02221918; Gaussian versus Student-t had eight worse and seven better cells. The separate formal-Anchor deficit was 0.052953. Its literal goal also requires that Anchor as code Parent, so the goal does not apply to this Child.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
